task: Binary classification — predicts whether a flood event will occur
known_limitations: Trained on synthetic data — not yet validated against real DHIS2/NDMA flood records
No temporal component — treats each observation independently
Community reports feature has zero importance — may indicate data quality issue
Perfect precision suggests potential overfitting on small dataset
intended_use: Decision support for flood early warnings in Sierra Leone. Not a substitute for hydrological expertise.
review_status: Pre-production — pending validation with real data
